Nearly six in ten U.S. adults own a wearable or connected health device, and nearly one in three used an AI chatbot for health questions. People are generating more health data than ever and actively looking for help understanding it, but their data and guidance still live in separate places. 

We saw this firsthand as family members struggled to piece together glucose readings for diabetes and blood tests for cardiovascular risk, all while juggling a pile of fitness, nutrition, and health-tracking apps that never talked to each other. 

People increasingly turn to ChatGPT or Claude for answers, but without continuous context to their health, the advice is often generic, incomplete, and difficult to track over time.

**Our solution:** 

Illume creates one home for your health and gives you a personal health companion you can text. 

Today, you can: 

* Connect your wearable and automatically sync sleep, activity, and recovery data 
* Text Illume photos of your meals to log and understand your nutrition 
* Record workouts and track your training 
* Upload bloodwork and lab results 
* Ask questions about your health using the context of your own data 
* Receive proactive insights about what changed, what it might mean, and what to do next

For example, you can ask: 

* “Why am I so exhausted today? Make me a dashboard of all the relevant metrics!” 
* “How has eating late affected my sleep?”
* “Am I recovering well enough to train? Run a regression!”
* “What should I focus on before my next blood test?”

Illume connects patterns across your data that individual platforms can’t see, giving you a more complete picture of your health instead of another isolated score or dashboard. 

You can text your Illume agent for quick answers or use the platform to explore your data, trends, and history in greater depth.

**Our mission**

Our long-term vision is to make healthcare more proactive, continuous, and personalized. 

By combining continuous biometrics with nutrition, training, blood panels, and eventually genetic risk, Illume could help surface meaningful changes earlier and help people understand their susceptibility to conditions such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and Alzheimer’s. 

We want to help people move from asking, “What happened?” to understanding what may be changing and what they can do about it. 

**Who’s it for:** Illume is initially designed for people who are proactive about their health and longevity- especially lifters, biohackers, and anyone already using wearables, blood panels, CGMs, nutrition trackers, or genetic testing.  

**Who we are:** We’re three MIT graduates who met in freshman year! 

[Pari Latawa](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paridhilatawa/): MIT BS & MEng in CS + Molecular Biology. Previously conducted research at the Broad Institute, Eli Lilly, & MD Anderson. Founded EasyComm to build tools for children with Down Syndrome, and SparkED, a health-literacy nonprofit.

[Frank Lee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/frank-lee-/): MIT BS in Computer Science and Mathematics. Conducted RLAIF research for language models at MIT CSAIL and previously built agent systems at Windsurf.

[Jin Wong](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jinwong01/): MIT BS in Business Analytics. Previously conducted research at the MIT Media Lab and deployed coding agents at Windsurf. 

**Our ask:** 

**Join the private beta waitlist at [www.illumelabs.ai](http://www.illumelabs.ai).** We’ll invite an initial group of founding members to receive early access and help shape the product. 

**If you want to chat or can intro us** to someone in training, sports, longevity, and/or biohacking, email us at [founders@illumelabs.ai](mailto:founders@illumelabs.ai). We’d love to stop by, chat, and show you how Illume works!

launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋

We're [Isaac](https://www.linkedin.com/in/isaactolley/) and [Marshall](https://www.linkedin.com/in/marshall-gould/), co-founders of [Juno](https://junocompanion.com/).

**TL;DR:** Juno is an AI personal health assistant for the 1B+ people living with chronic illness. Over 80,000 people already use Juno to reduce their symptoms and shorten the path to a diagnosis.

**_Ask:_** Know someone living with chronic illness? Send them [Juno](https://junocompanion.com/) - we support a broad range of conditions including fibromyalgia, long COVID, POTS, ME/CFS, EDS, endometriosis, lupus, MS and many more.

<https://youtu.be/KIxKP8iUG10>

#### ❌ The Problem

Over 1 billion people live with chronic illness: fibromyalgia, long COVID, POTS, ME/CFS, EDS, endometriosis, lupus, MS and many more.

* Patients spend months waiting for appointments, then get 15 minutes to explain years worth of symptoms
* The average diagnosis takes 7.6 years
* Many now turn to ChatGPT and Claude for advice, but without continuous context, the advice is generic and rarely actionable

#### 👬 Our Story

We started building Juno after growing up with chronic conditions ourselves. Isaac waited 14 years for an eosinophilic bronchitis diagnosis. Marshall lives with ME/CFS and is still searching for something that helps. We spent the last year conducting research at Oxford and UCL to understand what makes people engage with medical chatbots, to allow Juno to ask the right questions at the right time and comprehensively understand each user’s health. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101749&key=user_uploads/2576001/267e13c1-8296-4daf-8903-67cc817c56de)

#### 🩺 The Solution

Juno builds a longitudinal health profile from your conversations, biometrics, and medical history to provide:

* **💬 Personalised symptom advice** - guidance that actually makes sense for your body
* **📊 Continuous tracking** - symptoms logged automatically through natural conversation, by text or voice
* **🔍 Pattern detection** - identifies triggers and patterns over weeks and months
* **📄 Appointment-ready PDFs** - turn months of data into a summary your doctor can instantly understand

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101749&key=user_uploads/2576001/18c9d3ee-5e7f-4b89-9465-09ecf9ea380e)

#### 📈 Where we’re at (after 6 months)

* **80,000 users** globally, grown primarily through our organic content
* **9,000+ five-star** App Store reviews

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101749&key=user_uploads/2576001/277ec7df-3d59-4171-bb3b-e5fbda59ff1c)

#### 🙏 Our Asks

1. **Know someone with a chronic illness?** Please share Juno with them. We support a wide range of conditions including fibromyalgia, long COVID, POTS, ME/CFS, EDS, endometriosis, PCOS, lupus, MS, and many more. We'd love their feedback and hope it can be helpful.
2. **Intros to operators who've scaled consumer health products.** We're growing fast but Juno can reach far more people.

👉 Please share any feedback and contact us at [team@juno-chat.com](mailto:team@juno-chat.com)

 Download the app here: [https://junocompanion.com](https://junocompanion.com/)

launches.body:
# Lumeria is the Oura Ring for Skin:

TLDR: Lumeria is the Oura Ring for Skin: the Lumoscope clips onto your phone, scans your skin with the same multispectral light used in clinics, and Lumi, your AI skin coach, reads that history to personalize recommendations for you, so your routine is built on your data instead of someone else's.

Preorders are open at the $199 founding price until **August 16. After that, the price only goes up**. <https://lumeria.skin> 

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W-tz9FIQiOg>

## ❌ The problem

Anthea’s sister spent eight years chasing her eczema.

The cause turned out to be dust in the carpet.

No one caught it because no one was recording anything. Her skin was reacting to her sleep, her home, her products, the air around her, and none of it existed as data. Every dermatologist that took months to see started from zero. Every product she tried was a guess.

That is the **$190B** skincare industry in one story. It runs on guessing.

Lumeria ends that: it captures the missing data layer that gives you the power to understand and own your skin's health data, from home.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109979&key=user_uploads/3470868/08058377-6a96-414b-b03e-44ff36f8622a)

## 🔬 How it works

The Lumoscope shrinks the multi-spectrum imaging dermatology clinics use into a clip for your phone. Press it against your skin and see yourself in three kinds of light: true color (RGB), UV, and cross-polarized.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109979&key=user_uploads/3470868/76776eef-52f9-4416-827c-36c74760f8dd)

For the first time, you see what your mirror can't: a breakout building days before it surfaces, sun damage hiding under flawless-looking skin, where inflammation is building up.

Each scan becomes an objective read (hydration, redness, evenness, pigmentation, texture, pores) plus a score out of 100 and a skin age, so you can understand your progress.

Track them over time, and Lumi tells you exactly what to do. 

* It finds the cause, linking your breakouts to habits you'd never think of, from your sleep to your cycle to the pillowcase you forgot to wash. 
* It recommends products from a database of 18000+ products + ingredients, matched to what your scans actually show works.
* It hands your dermatologist 90 days of images, trends, and context in one tap.
* And it compounds: every scan adds to a history and increased understanding of your skin’s relevant context.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109979&key=user_uploads/3470868/c36570ca-4042-47bc-beb4-5f1a27014d6a)

 It works across every skin tone. It is private and encrypted by default. 

## 👥 Why we built this

Anthea, our CTO, lived with this problem: suffering from eczema that would not heal, five months to reach a dermatologist, four misdiagnoses. She is an engineer who worked on computational biology at Google and Boehringer Ingelheim. Maryanne, our CEO, is a skincare creator with 25M+ views across her UGC portfolio, exited her first biotech company by 19, and still could not explain her own breakouts until Lumeria. We understand the helplessness people feel with their skin, so we built what was needed.

We are patent pending, shipping in Fall 2026, and built on 150+ interviews and 2 clinical partnerships with dermatologists and patients.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109979&key=user_uploads/3470868/d7da4795-da8c-4edd-8c96-58e540656067)

## 🚀 Why preorder right now

This is the best moment there will ever be to own a Lumoscope:

* **$199 until August 16.** The founding price is the lowest it will ever be, and it will go up to 329 otherwise. 
* **Founding preorders are first in line.** Units ship Sep - Oct 2026, ahead of general release.
* **3 months of Premium free** plus a 30-day money-back guarantee.
* **Founding member, not a ticket number:** a direct line to us and a real say in what we build next.
* **Your skin data compounds from day one:** the earlier you set your baseline, the sooner your recommendations are built on your skin instead of averages.

Preorder now at <https://lumeria.skin>

See what Lumi has to say about your skin, and own your skin’s story today. ☀️

💛 Reach out to us: [maryanne@lumeria.skin](mailto:maryanne@lumeria.skin) & [anthea@lumeria.skin](mailto:anthea@lumeria.skin)
